header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ: الرَّاحِمُوْنَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمنُ، ارْحَمُوْا اَهْلَ اْلاَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب فِي الرحمة رقم:٤٩٤١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “The Most Merciful, “Allah”, shows mercy to those who show mercy. Show mercy to those on the earth, and the One in the heavens will show mercy to you.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْمَجَالِسُ بِالْاَمَانَةِ اِلَّا ثَلَاثَةَ مَجَالِسَ: سَفْكُ دَمٍ حَرَامٍ، اَوْ فَرْجٌ حَرَامٌ، اَوِ اقْتِطَاعُ مَالٍ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في نقل الحديث رقم:٤٨٦٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) has narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The trust (amanah) of gatherings must be safeguarded, and the secrets spoken in them must be kept, except for three gatherings! (They are not to be kept; rather, it is necessary to tell others about them.) 1. A secret spoken about unjustly killing someone, 2. A secret spoken about committing adultery, 3. A secret spoken about unjustly seizing someone's wealth.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- These three actions have been mentioned in the hadith as examples. The meaning of the hadith is that if a sinful secret or an unjust secret consultation takes place in any gathering, and you also took part in that gathering, that secret must never be concealed.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْمُؤْمِنُ مَنْ اَمِنَهُ النَّاسُ عَلَي دِمَائِهِمْ وَاَمْوَالِهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي باب صفة المؤمن رقم:٤٩٩٨
